name: norvia-monorepo
description: Monorepo corporativo Norvia: Frontend Next.js, API Gateway Node.js e Automações Independentes

scripts.test:nfe: cd backend/automations/automacoes-financeiro && (pytest tests/ -v 2>/dev/null || uv run --python 3.11 --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt pytest tests/ -v)
scripts.test: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:gateway && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:nfe && npm run test:producao && npm run test:marketplace
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:frontend
scripts.audit:npm: npm --prefix backend/gateway audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.audit:python: for m in automacoes-financeiro automacoes-marketplace automacoes-producao contagem-estoque; do (cd backend/automations/$m && uvx --python 3.11 pip-audit==2.10.1 -r requirements.txt --progress-spinner off) || exit 1; done
scripts.audit: npm run audit:secrets && npm run audit:npm && npm run audit:python
